title: HEART Engine is an AI-Powered Public Interest Tech Certification Platform to Build Future AI Public Interest Workforce
summary: HEART Engine describes AI-assisted learning pathways, conversational support, and job matching; learning and employment gains are not quantified.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: HEART Engine uses adaptive prompts, supervised recommendation models, and conversational agents to personalize training and connect learners with opportunities. Spelman College and Ebenezer Baptist Church are listed as testbeds. Learning and placement gains remain unquantified.
purpose: Personalize learning and employment guidance through AI-assisted recommendations and dialogue.
location: Spelman College and Ebenezer Baptist Church, Atlanta, United States

ratings.reason: AI-assisted personalization and matching are described, but completed learning or employment gains are not quantified.
AI helps deliver the training service, but improved training throughput or placement performance is not established.
Reduced hiring bias and greater digital equity through AI-assisted matching remain intended.

ai_role.statement: Recommendation models and conversational AI adapt training and matching to learner profiles and regional context.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: HEART Engine is an AI-Powered Public Interest Tech Certification Platform to Build Future AI Public Interest Workforce

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: HEART Engine uses AI to personalize training and matching
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
